source: Club scorecard Scorekort-2023.pdf (angsogolfklubb.com), machine-extracted and internally consistent: the per-hole metres reproduce the printed UT 3112 and S:a 6289 (Vit) and 5850 (Gul) exactly. Confirmed hole-by-hole against caddee.se and golfisverige.com, which differ only on hole 1 (see note).
note: Par 72 (36 out / 36 in). Five tees, metres. Course by Åke Hultström, opened 1985; club founded 1979. Hole 1 was LENGTHENED between the 2020 and 2023 cards (Vit 355 -> 386, Gul 336 -> 350); the older figures are still served by several third-party sites and by the club's own LiveCaddie banguide. 386 is used here because it is what makes the printed totals add up. Par 3s: 3, 9, 12, 15. Par 5s: 5, 7, 10, 18.

slope.structure: The tables are split by sex and are deliberately ASYMMETRIC — men are rated from Vit/Gul/Blå/Röd (no Orange), women from Gul/Blå/Röd/Orange (no Vit). This is not a gap in the research: those combinations are genuinely unpublished and are recorded null rather than cross-filled. Hole19 lists exactly the same 8 rated sets (white, yellow m/l, blue m/l, red m/l, orange), and slope.no states '4 tees för herrar och 4 för damer'.
slope.agreement: THREE INDEPENDENT PATHS AGREE DIGIT FOR DIGIT on the values above: the club's own Slopetabell-Herrar-2023.pdf and Slopetabell-Damer-2023.pdf (Report A), slope.no checked 2026-08-28, and Hole19's embedded tee JSON (Report B). The club's /slope/ page quotes the two headline figures 'Herrar Gul: 70,9/128. Damer röd: 68,9/114', matching.
slope.dissenting: GolfPass alone publishes a uniformly higher set — Vit 74.0/140, Gul 71.9/136, Blå 68.5/129, Röd 65.3/123 for men; 77.4/135, 73.3/126, 69.4/118, 63.8/106 for women. Every value is 0.4-1.0 higher on CR and 5-7 higher on slope, which is the signature of a pre-WHS rating rather than a transcription error. Not adopted.
slope.caveat: slope.no names the club's own 2023 PDF as its upstream, so it corroborates rather than independently confirms. Hole19 is the one genuinely separate lineage.
